描述_EN: it has two parts - a bowl with holes on the base and a tripod.the cook would fill the tripod with water and place a bamboo basket containing food in the bowl. a fire would be lit beneath the tripod to make the water boil and give off steam to cook the food. the chinese name for this vessel is yan, meaning a 'steamer'.
描述_ZN: 它有两个部分--一个底座上有孔的碗和一个三脚架。厨师会在三脚架里装满水，然后把装有食物的竹篮放在碗里。 在鼎的下面点火，使水沸腾并发出蒸汽来烹调食物。 这个器皿的中文名字是Yan，意思是 "蒸笼"。
